description: This file defines the ViewAssignClaimController class for the OrangeHRM Claim module. The controller extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component with employee claim data based on the authenticated user.

classes.name: ViewAssignClaimController
classes.description: Controller for handling the view related to assigning claims to employees, sets up a Vue component with employee number.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and sets up the Vue component ('employee-claim') with the authenticated employee's number before rendering.
